task.title: Needs-adjacent board-grain residue: suggested_destinations blind, add_desire guard, NoLongerNeeded phrasing, PickRow dup, planner id re-scan
task.description:
From P6-074 adversarial review (2026-08-12), filed while the major (elsewhere apportioning) is fixed in-PR:

1. hosted.rs ~:1807 suggested_destinations still aggregates desires/holdings per collection board-blind — a deck whose only gap is on side isn't offered as a quick-add destination; now inconsistent with /needs.
2. hosted.rs ~:1283 add_desire has no deck-only board guard (unlike set_desire_board ~:2546); with to_board threading, a pull could create a non-main holding inside a binder if data ever carries a non-main binder desire. Defensive today (binder desires are all main).
3. needs.rs ~:172 SkipReason::NoLongerNeeded is also reported when the need stands but the named source was drained by an earlier line of the same walk — phrase misdescribes the state; split the reason or reword.
4. needs.rs ~:346 PickRow.board duplicates PickRow.item.board — two fields to keep in step.
5. pull_plan.rs ~:207-221 the write recovers the holding row by re-scanning snapshot.holdings on six grain fields; plan_pull could carry holdings.id instead.
